title: GuardFed: A Trustworthy Federated Learning Framework Against Dual-Facet Attacks
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical aspects of group fairness and robustness in federated learning. It evaluates metrics like Absolute Statistical Parity Difference (ASPD) and Absolute Equalized Opportunity Difference (AEOD) to defend against adversarial attacks. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, spiritual, or ethical moral frameworks as its primary component.
